_comment: TOOL is public source code and documentation.
FIXTURE is synthetic test data generated by tools/make_fixtures.py.
DATA is real runtime output in a PRIVATE versioned companion repository.
Real DATA never exists in this public source tree, including ignored paths.
_audited: Audited store, worker evidence, run logs and immutable baselines, ingest cursors/inboxes, registry writes, digest records, creation/link/action receipts, notification receipts and prepared payloads. Receipts share the admitted SQLite database. Action workspaces and transient notification-payloads are PRIVATE output. Writers resolve DATA through the companion and refuse destinations inside the public source tree or Git metadata before creating output; there is no in-repo fallback. Explicit database paths do not bypass this check.
_data_home: SCHEDULE_REMINDER_DATA_DIR or the data directory of SCHEDULE_REMINDER_CONFIG. PRIVATE companion DATA is versioned and backed up; PUBLIC, unknown and unmanaged destinations fail closed.
